subject: Request: short trial runway + top-up options
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightwell.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short trial runway + top-up options

Hi Lauren,

Hope you had a good weekend. Quick ask from our side — exec review on Friday pushed the deployment decision out by two weeks. We’re close, but need either a 2-week extension to the current trial window or a small top-up of credits so engineering can finish a final integration check before the PO.

Would Redwood be willing to extend the trial by 14 days, or alternatively add a one-time credit of ~$1,500 to avoid re-architecting the test harness? We can move fast on procurement if needed — attaching our most recent usage export so you can see where we landed.

Attachments:
- usage-report-apr.csv (csv)

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
Brightwell AI
elaine@brightwell.ai

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightwell.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial runway + top-up options

Hi Elaine — thanks for the note and for sharing the usage file. Appreciate the heads up about the exec timeline. Two straightforward options we can offer: 

1) Trial runway extension: add 14 calendar days to your active time-boxed evaluation at no charge. This keeps the current metrics intact and avoids any billing changes.

2) One-time credit: $1,500 in platform credits that can be consumed immediately; trial window stays the same.

One caveat: the extension requires a brief amendment to the SOW to document new end date; the credit option needs finance sign-off for one-off credit issuance. If either works for you I’ll route internally and send the doc/DocuSign link.

If helpful, we can also propose a hybrid: 7-day extension + $750 credit. Happy to work toward whichever minimizes procurement friction on your side. 

Let me know preference and I’ll take it to finance/legal.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
Phone: (415) 555-0132
